target: AArch64 PCI QEMU, one guest CPU, current desktop ISO
command: ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-tosmisc-dollar-current.log QEMU_VIRT='-machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-demo-system-context --demo-system-path /Demo/AcctExample/TOS/TOSMisc.ZC --demo-system-module /Demo/AcctExample/TOS/TOSConfig.ZC --demo-system-module /System/Gr/ScreenCast.ZC --demo-system-module /Apps/Psalmody/JukePuppet.ZC --demo-system-module /System/BlkDev/DiskCheck.ZC --demo-system-module /Demo/AcctExample/TOS/TOSMisc.ZC
verified: TOSConfig initialized the expected CD/C drive definitions (tos-config=CD|C||).
DC2Doc recognized an exact A bitmap with zero mismatch and saved adjacent AZ text with zero mismatch.
DC2Doc returned zero bitmap mismatch for each of the 94 printable ASCII glyph bitmaps (0x21 through 0x7E), including the dollar glyph.
For the dollar glyph, DocSave produced leading bytes 36, 36, 10, 5, 0, confirming the literal dollar encoding and saved text prefix.
Stock DiskCheck('D',FALSE,FALSE) returned zero on the disposable explicitly mounted read-only RedSea fixture; see the disk-check follow-up in redsea-guest-drive-qemu-2026-11-09.json.
not_verified: ScreenCast/movie capture, JukePuppet media playback, memory allocation stress and the DiskCheckAll configured-drive workflow were not invoked.
Live UTM, Pi hardware and audio capture/playback behavior.

audio_followup.command: ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-tosmisc-audio-current.log QEMU_VIRT='-machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-demo-system-context --demo-system-path /Demo/AcctExample/TOS/TOSMisc.ZC --demo-system-module /Demo/AcctExample/TOS/TOSConfig.ZC --demo-system-module /System/Gr/ScreenCast.ZC --demo-system-module /Apps/Psalmody/JukePuppet.ZC --demo-system-module /System/BlkDev/DiskCheck.ZC --demo-system-module /Demo/AcctExample/TOS/TOSMisc.ZC
verified: SoundShift removes a sound event after its shifted time falls before its predecessor and preserves the later event.
AUWrite writes an 18-byte AU file containing the sentinel and retained sound event; FileRead reopens it and verifies a nonzero timestamp and the event's ona value.

scope_note: Expanded non-destructive OCR helper coverage, including saved DolDoc dollar encoding, plus a separate read-only DiskCheck check on the RedSea guest-drive fixture and a SoundShift/AUWrite AU-file round trip. TOSMisc remains partial because capture, media playback, allocation stress and the configured-drive DiskCheckAll workflow are not yet runtime-tested.
